system.description:
Deal [2D + (Magic Power)] magical damage to the target.

(Effect): You gain a +[SRx4] bonus to damage rolls with the [Cold] and [Shock] tags. Treat this effect as a Combat Status.

An offensive spell that summons a powerful storm to strike down enemies in a wide area. The storm lingers for a while, empowering the storms and thunder you control. As long as the storm does not dissipate, the battlefield is your domain.
